work_summary: Profiled tnf doctor at 108s cold / ~34s typical: launcher ran pnpm exec tsx on the 22k-line cli.ts every invocation (~13s warm, ~50s cold), tsc --build incremental never refreshed dist mtimes, and tnf-doctor.cjs ran independent probes serially.

Repo launcher tnf now prefers node packages/tnf-cli/dist/cli.js when dist passes mtime freshness (newest of packages/tnf-cli/src/** and data/providers/catalog.json vs dist), silently rebuilds once when stale, falls back to tsx, and honors TNF_CLI_USE_TSX=1.
packages/tnf-cli build now stamps dist/cli.js after tsc --build so incremental no-op builds still register dist as fresh.

scripts/tnf-doctor.cjs starts the gcloud/wrangler/gh auth checks and the WhatsApp bridge probe concurrently at the top of main, parallelizes port probes and live-API health fetches, enforces a 30s hard timeout per shell check, and drops the dead sync helpers.

verification.notes: tnf --version 13-58s -> 4.1s (direct dist: 3.1s). tnf doctor end-to-end 108s cold -> 6.5-8s, result PASS, panels unchanged. node scripts/tnf-doctor.cjs 22.5s -> 3.0s; node --check and prettier clean. --skip-live-checks strict FAIL on missing DATABASE_URL verified pre-existing.

resume_checklist: Run tnf doctor from a cold shell and confirm single-digit seconds.
